after customer rebooting our charger via OCPP, charger came back online.
now i can see this error messages

after reboot charger didn'T come back.
Customer was on site and also reboot the charger like:
STOP -> FC12 -> START -> FC12
and STOP -> FC12 -> QA2 OFF -> QA2 ON -> START -> FC12
I can see logs in SCB but no errorflags. Reboot is also not possible anymore over SCB

we had to install a brand new CFAST Card and also create a new SCB entry since the old config didn't work.
after a lot of problems we finaly got it work.
it looks like there was a factory or SCB problem.
